text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder collapses during<n>training. I rush her
to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: Were you not feeling well this morning?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I wasn't. But I thought I could push<n>through it for a
single training session.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect this... Training will<n>have to be put on
hold for the<n>foreseeable future, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer... please see to your work.
choice_data_list: I'll be here until you're back on your feet.
Once you're rested, we can get right back to it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You're really not going to leave, are<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes... Yes, I suppose you're right.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't have to see me in such<n>a miserable
state.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I spend time in the infirmary with a<n>depressed
Grass Wonder until she<n>feels better.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: All right. Thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder seemed a little on<n>edge, so I give
her some time alone to<n>recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I don't have time to be just sitting<n>here... Why did
this have to happen?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hear how upset she is, even from<n>the other side of
the infirmary's door.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. We seem to be so in sync<n>that I
couldn't help but laugh.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much. I'll commit<n>myself to recovery
and be back to full<n>strength in no time. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder's recovery takes a<n>while. But once
she's back on her<n>feet, she remains true to her
word<n>and makes up for lost time.
